_comment: Phase 9 outreach angle -- a rule-based conversation starter assembled ONLY from signals this pipeline already computed (Phases 2-8), never free-form generated text and never a claim about the owner's personal situation beyond what the recorded documents show. This is a starting point for a human caller to verify and adapt, not a script -- see README's compliance note. Fragments are combined, not first-match-wins, since several conditions often apply to the same lead (e.g. an out-of-state landlord with chronic code violations).
review_required_prefix: Confirm the actual decision-maker before discussing terms -- the named party may not have authority to sell.

fragments.tax_imminent: Tax deed auction is imminent -- lead with urgency and certainty of a fast, guaranteed closing.
fragments.foreclosure_judgment: Foreclosure judgment entered -- Florida law typically schedules the sale within weeks; lead with speed and closing certainty.
fragments.code_repeat: Chronic code violations suggest deferred maintenance -- an as-is cash offer removes the repair burden.
fragments.landlord_multi_distress: Portfolio owner facing distress on more than one property -- lead with a simple, low-effort exit for this one.
fragments.absentee_out_of_state: Owner's mailing address is out of state -- lead with convenience and not having to manage the property remotely.

tier_baseline.A: Strong overall lead -- prioritize a direct call.
tier_baseline.B: Solid lead -- worth a prompt call.
tier_baseline.C: Moderate lead -- worth a call, verify details first.
tier_baseline.D: Lower priority -- research further before contacting.
tier_baseline.E: Low priority -- confirm the data checks out before spending outreach time here.
